answer: YES for Asmodian Sealed Dungeons: every sampled band (10-40) lists 2 Wisdom Stone + 2 Daevanion Crystal (+15,000 Kina, 1,250 Enhance Stone, 2 Featherdown) in the Standard clear reward table.
caveats: Metabot lists one Standard clear-reward table; it does not say whether this is first-clear only or repeatable. Treat as first clear (the app's current assumption) - unverified.

allthings.how Place of Rest guide (https://allthings.how/?p=244902) shows a second, conflicting table (1,200 Enhance Stone, Eremation Crystal, Featherbeam, no Crystal) - likely an older/other-mode table; Metabot shows 2/2.
Abyss Points 1,000 appear only in the Elyos column; Elyos get 2,500 Enhance Stone and NO Wisdom/Crystal.
Strongholds: Metabot quest pages list only EXP (no Wisdom/Crystal); allthings mentions a Treasure Chest + achievement/title without counts. CLEAR_REWARD +2/+2 should NOT be applied to strongholds.
Story quests Lv 41-45 (Metabot): no Wisdom Stone / Daevanion Crystal listed on any of the 11 pages.
Dungeon XP is not on dungeon pages; it is the EXP of each dungeon's separate Exploration quest (quest ids 2810xxx). No list page exposes it.
